scope: New single-task development-informed external study. Detector operating point is exploratory, not confidence-qualified. Earlier failed protocols remain unchanged.
screen: 87/100 strict-correct, 100/100 valid, gain .37 on new confirmation; chosen from three formats on a separate40-example development set.
router: BGE/span fixed by BIPIA known-domain calibration before summarization final features; no SST2 outcome changes router.
trust_boundary: Task instruction and four disjoint training demonstrations trusted. All current-example text is untrusted. Generic observed-text sentence/newline/64-word segmentation; no attack offset, clean counterpart or current-example gold label enters decisions.
serialization: Tokenize the full rendered prompt once, assign tokens to generic regions, and select identical token streams for filtering and state-bank routing. Stop on boundary or generated-token equivalence failures.
attack_validity: Generate all undefended attacks first. Proceed to attacked defended arms only if paired strict target-accuracy drop>=10 percentage points OR strict spam-task attacker success>=10%. Otherwise retain clean-arm utility/equivalence controls and stop efficacy interpretation. Published attacker parser retained separately.
metrics: Strict/published target accuracy, strict/published attacker-task ASR, per-family and paired-source summaries. Clean utility and source-cluster bootstrap condition on this chosen configuration.
